# strip-ansi [![Build Status](https://example.invalid/chalk/strip-ansi.svg?branch=master)](https://example.invalid/chalk/strip-ansi)

> Strip [ANSI escape codes](https://example.invalid/wiki/ANSI_escape_code) from a string

## Install

```
$ npm install strip-ansi
```


## Usage

```js
const stripAnsi = require('strip-ansi');

stripAnsi('\u001B[4mUnicorn\u001B[0m');
//=> 'Unicorn'

stripAnsi('\u001B]8;;https://example.invalid\u0007Click\u001B]8;;\u0007');
//=> 'Click'
```
